items.headline: Baleba trains at Carrington ahead of Brighton Carabao Cup match
items.summary: Carlos Baleba training with Manchester United squad after completing transfer from Brighton; expected to return to group in coming days.

items.headline: Manchester United announce three professional contracts to academy players
items.summary: Club hands out three professional contracts to academy players for 2026/27 season; negotiations with Noah Ajayi reportedly close.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel requests departure from Manchester United academy
items.summary: 15-year-old academy prospect JJ Gabriel has asked to leave club; Real Madrid and Barcelona reported to be monitoring situation.
